title: Whipped Cream Cheese and Caramel Apple Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, softened to room temperature
Granny Smith apples, sliced, for serving
instructions: Step 1: Combine all ingredients (except apples) in a large mixing bowl. Using a hand-held or stand mixer, whip until the sugar fully dissolves into the cream cheese, scraping the bowl sides as necessary. Continue mixing if grainy until smooth and creamy.
Step 2: Serve immediately with sliced apples, or refrigerate in an airtight container for 4-5 days.
notes: From the Fork in the Kitchen reel (link in the caption). Caramel flavor/extract is essential and is usually found near the vanilla extract. Any apple works, but tart Granny Smith balances the sweet dip best. Equipment: hand mixer.
